# anyscale_role_binding (Resource)

~> **Alpha.** Role bindings are an Alpha feature behind a feature flag; contact [support@anyscale.com](mailto:support@anyscale.com) for access. The Anyscale API and this provider's schema for them may change drastically before Beta, including breaking changes in a minor release. See the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md#role-bindings-alpha).

Grants one role to one user group on an organization, cloud or project. Access granted this way is not visible to `anyscale_cloud_access`; see the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md). A binding cannot be edited, so changing any argument replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Alpha, behind a feature flag (contact support@anyscale.com for access). The schema may change before Beta.
# Grants one role to one user group on exactly one of a cloud, a project, or the organization.
# A binding cannot be edited: changing any argument replaces it.
variable "project_id" {
  description = "ID of an existing Anyscale project (prj_...)"
  type        = string
}

data "anyscale_role" "project_viewer" {
  name = "project_viewer" # exact, case-sensitive
}

resource "anyscale_user_group" "analysts" {
  name = "analysts"
}

resource "anyscale_role_binding" "analysts_project_viewer" {
  user_group_id = anyscale_user_group.analysts.id
  role_id       = data.anyscale_role.project_viewer.id
  project_id    = var.project_id # exactly one of cloud_id, project_id, organization_id

  # Avoid a window with no access when role_id changes.
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) The role to grant (`rol_...`); look one up by name with the `anyscale_role` data source. Changing it replaces the binding, leaving the group without the role in between unless the resource sets `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }`.
- `user_group_id` (String) The user group that holds the role (`ug_...`). Groups synced from an identity provider are accepted.

### Optional

- `cloud_id` (String) Grant the role on this cloud. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `organization_id` (String) Grant the role on the organization: the token's own, as returned by the `anyscale_organization` data source. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `project_id` (String) Grant the role on this project. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the binding.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the grant was made.
- `created_by` (String) The ID of the user who made the grant. Null when the API does not know.
- `id` (String) The role binding ID (`rb_...`).
- `origin` (String) How the grant was made, as the API records it, for example `imperative`. Null when the API does not know.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using the role binding ID. Only bindings held by a user group can be imported.
terraform import anyscale_role_binding.analysts_project_viewer rb_abc123
```
